symbols.name: digit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in one digit, a count of bits.
symbols.quote: Let $b$ be the number of bits in one digit; here $b$ does not mean the second input sequence of the cyclic convolution page.

symbols.name: digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of digits in each input, a count of digits.
symbols.quote: Let $m$ be the number of digits in each input.

symbols.name: first input integer
symbols.meaning: The first of the two integers being multiplied.
symbols.quote: Let $U$ be the first input and $V$ the second.

symbols.name: second input integer
symbols.meaning: The second of the two integers being multiplied.
symbols.quote: Let $U$ be the first input and $V$ the second.

relations.quote: Multiplication reduces to [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) of short integer coefficients.
